guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is active low (asynchronous reset), idle_q is forced to 1'b1.
On rising edge of clk_i while rst_ni is high, idle_q takes the value of idle_d.

assumptions.claim: The signal idle_d must be correctly driven by upstream logic to reflect the intended idle state of the HMAC core at all times when rst_ni is high.
assumptions.cond: After reset de-assertion and on every clock edge
assumptions.risk: If idle_d is glitched, undefined, or incorrectly computed, idle_q will capture a wrong value, potentially causing the HMAC core to falsely appear busy or idle, breaking protocol handshakes and possibly leading to unsafe operation.

uncertain_points.claim: Chunk metadata indicates a compile-time guard 'generate if: !rst_ni', which would be illegal if rst_ni is a signal; this may be a parsing artifact or a real parameter‑based conditional instantiation that needs verification.
uncertain_points.cond: Unknown; requires source review of the surrounding generate construct.
uncertain_points.risk: If the guard is real and mis-extracted, the chunk's presence in the netlist could be misinterpreted, leading to incomplete verification coverage (e.g., assuming the flip-flop always exists when it might be omitted).
